verdict: Leads are coming in efficiently — but none are converting to booked visits.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 122 leads at a cost of $11.90 per lead — a 26% improvement in efficiency over the prior week. That efficiency gain came alongside a 33% reduction in spend, so volume did soften slightly; the lower cost per lead reflects budget compression, not a breakthrough in targeting. The more pressing signal is downstream: 81 opportunities are sitting in your pipeline with zero converted and zero appointments booked this period, which points to a leak in how leads are being followed up, not a problem with the ads themselves. We're actively working to close the attribution and contact data gaps so the full leads-to-patients chain is visible and trusted before the end of August.

watch_item.issue: Leads are entering the pipeline but not converting to appointments — the drop-off is happening at intake, not at the ad level.
